sentences.text:
Shri Hemant Sharma-GA appearing on behalf of Advocat  Shri Ritvik Mishra - Advocate for the respondent no.
 ORDER 1] Counsel for the respondent no.2 has submitted that the impugned order dated 2.3.2024, passed by JMFC Ratlam, has already been set aside by the District Revisional Court passed in Criminal Revision No.54/2024, which was filed by the respondent no.2, and the matter has been remanded back to the trial Court.
2] Shri Ajay Bagadia, learned senior counsel for the petitioners, has submitted that the matter has not been remanded back to the trial Court in respect of section 420 of the IPC which is the subject matter of challenge in the present petition.
However, it is not denied that the impugned order was also challenged by the respondent no.2 in the criminal revision in the District Court.

Considering the fact that the same order was challenged in NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:8497 2 MCRC-12789-2024 the District Revisional Court by the complainant as also by the accused in the present petition under section 482 of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973, whereas, the Revision has already been allowed by the District Revisional Court and the matter has already been remanded back to the trial Court, this Court finds it Harshad Mehta vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 31 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113394433/
1 expedient to dispose of this petition with a direction to the trial Court to decide all the issues afresh including the applicability of Section 420 of the IPC against the present petitioners without being influenced by the impugned order passed earlier after giving due opportunity of hearing to the parties concerned.
